finding: Epidural anesthesia and the intensity of pretraumatic stress symptoms were independently associated with the intensity of fear of childbirth (FOC) symptoms, while planning a c-section and epidural anesthesia were predictors of FOC and tokophobia.
mod_finding: Planning an epidural anesthesia was an independent predictor of both FOC and tokophobia (β = 1.33, p = 0.03; β = 1.26, p = 0.04, respectively).
